body.intent: CI on a pull request runs only the model checks when nothing outside .rhiza/ changed since the pull request's last commit whose CI passed, so ship land's push and merges of main that bring only .rhiza/ changes cost a model check instead of a full CI round. Evidence: wait-landed is a full CI round in every run, 5.9m median (perf report rec 1).
body.title: CI since last green
